<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#1018280D"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="19" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">9:41</text>

  <g>

    <circle cx="352" cy="44" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="352" cy="53" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Five-step progress -->
  <g>

    <polyline points="121,101 126,106 135,96" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="219" cy="101" r="17" fill="url(#brand)" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <polyline points="212,101 217,106 226,96" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>

    <circle cx="310" cy="101" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="310" y1="101" x2="310" y2="97" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="310" y1="101" x2="314" y2="104" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="101" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="101" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="20" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Order</text>
    <text x="108" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Reason</text>
    <text x="195" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Method</text>
    <text x="289" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Review</text>
    <text x="343" y="130" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#CFCBDC">Done</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="170" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Review your return request</text>
    <text x="20" y="194" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Check the details below before submitting.</text>

    <!-- Order summary card -->
    <rect x="18" y="213" width="354" height="205" rx="8" fill="#0C0C0D66" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="18" y="211" width="354" height="205" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="34" y="238" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Order review</text>
    <text x="34" y="260" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Order #114-7829451-3087426</text>
    <text x="354" y="260" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Jun 18, 2026</text>
    <line x1="34" y1="274" x2="356" y2="274" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Product 1 -->
    <rect x="34" y="289" width="52" height="52" rx="8" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="299" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="40,334 53,317 61,326 69,317 80,334" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="98" y="304" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Wireless noise-canceling headphones</text>
    <text x="98" y="324" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Black · Qty 1 · Damaged on arrival</text>
    <text x="354" y="344" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">$129.99</text>

    <!-- Product 2 -->
    <line x1="34" y1="357" x2="356" y2="357" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="34" y="371" width="52" height="30" rx="6" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="378" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="40,398 53,385 61,392 69,384 80,398" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="98" y="382" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">USB-C charging cable, 2-pack</text>
    <text x="98" y="401" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">White · Qty 1 · Wrong item received</text>

    <!-- Details -->
    <text x="20" y="453" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Return details</text>
    <rect x="18" y="467" width="354" height="112" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="34" y="492" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">RETURN METHOD</text>
    <text x="34" y="514" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Drop off at a nearby location</text>
    <text x="34" y="540" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Free return · Label provided after submission</text>
    <line x1="34" y1="551" x2="356" y2="551" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="34" y="570" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">REFUND TO</text>
    <text x="115" y="570" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Original payment method · $159.98</text>

    <!-- Confirmation -->
    <rect x="20" y="603" width="17" height="17" rx="3" fill="url(#brand)" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="24,611 28,615 34,608" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="47" y="616" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">I confirm the return details are correct.</text>
    <text x="20" y="643" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">You can track your return status from your orders after submission.</text>

    <!-- Footer actions -->
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="673" width="104" height="40" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="72" y="698" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Back</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="134" y="673" width="236" height="40" rx="8" fill="url(#brand)" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
      <text x="252" y="698" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Submit return request</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="752" width="390" height="92" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,778 49,770 59,778 59,790 53,790 53,782 45,782 45,790 39,790" fill="#0D0543"/>

    <circle cx="270" cy="778" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>

    <ellipse cx="344" cy="784" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#0D0543"/>
